note: Verification certificate for a published worked example of the known-key historical three-rotor Enigma (Enigma I, the military form of the commercial Enigma). Rotors I II III, wide B reflector, rings AAA, start AAA, empty plugboard, as printed on Wikipedia's Enigma rotor details page. Not a break of an unsolved intercept. Not a claim about army message Nr. 86 or Kryptos K4.
